## ReportWriterFormulaReferences

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Reporting.ReportWriterFormulaReferences</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Reporting/ReportWriterFormulaReferences.cs:12](../../../../src/Meridian.Reporting/ReportWriterFormulaReferences.cs#L12).

Shared rule for reading bare (unbraced) formula references that contain hyphens. Hyphens are legal inside field names, so net-pnl can be one field; but operators also write pnl-fees meaning subtraction. The longest known name wins: the whole identifier when it is a known field, otherwise the longest hyphen-delimited prefix that is known, with the rest left for the caller to read as a subtraction. An identifier with no known prefix is returned whole so the &quot;not found&quot; message still names what the operator typed. Braced references ({net-pnl}) are never split.

```csharp
public static class ReportWriterFormulaReferences
```
